data.description: Automatically match and download accurate subtitles for NAS videos
data.descriptionEn: Automatically match and download accurate subtitles for NAS videos
data.descriptionZh: 自动为NAS影片匹配并下载精准字幕，看片不再缺字幕
data.readme:
· Match the right subtitles for your films/TV series, filterable by language (Chinese, English, Korean, Japanese, etc.).
· When multiple subtitles are found, lists them for selection
· Confirm before downloading subtitles
data.readmeEn:
· Match the right subtitles for your films/TV series, filterable by language (Chinese, English, Korean, Japanese, etc.).
· When multiple subtitles are found, lists them for selection
· Confirm before downloading subtitles
data.readmeZh:
· 帮你给当前影片查找字幕，可按中文、英文、韩语、日语等语言筛选
· 找到多条字幕时，会先列出来让你选择
· 需要下载字幕时，确认后再处理
